menu.export-hint: Save every changed world, player and client setting to a JSON file.
menu.import-hint: Load a previously exported settings file and choose which settings to apply.

settings.max-diff-hint: How many characters of each value to show in the import comparison window. Display-only truncation: it never affects what is exported or imported. Set to 0 to show full values.
settings.include-defaults-hint: Turn on for full-backup exports, otherwise leave off to exclude default values (note: importing will skip that value entirely).
